reason: P1 preserved the accepted scientific digest but failed its workplan acceptance requirement for material product wall-time improvement. The two-selector progressive direct prepass took about 118 seconds outside the canonical four-worker rung queue, while the baseline direct TARGET-DATA2B work had already overlapped with other rung jobs. Repeat 1 therefore increased builder wall time from the 418-second warm baseline to approximately 453 seconds. One repeat is sufficient to reject P1 as a performance optimization; a second repeat is not required to demonstrate material improvement after the observed regression.
p2_basis: Baseline P0 evidence attributes approximately 72.9 percent of measured lane time to repeated sparse MVIDX telemetry. P2 therefore targets incremental exact sparse telemetry while preserving canonical scientific reductions and worker-independent output.
